posts.name: S.Vignesh
posts.cooked:
This can be done with a few sed commands. The most obvious being the substitute command s.

Hint: Look up the hold space commands h and g .

Solution:
script.sed

#!/usr/bin/sed -Ef
/x+x/{
      s/x/0/g
      h
     }
/x +x/g
/\**\*/ s/\*/x/g;

script.sh

#!/usr/bin/bash 
./script.sed $1
